question: Does the first-party https://drive.uc.cn page publish the free promo quota and the 1 GB per-file cap that the record attributes to third-party forum posts?
why: The first-party page read on 2026-11-25 advertises only the paid SVIP 6 TB tier; the free 1 TB promo and 1 GB per-file figures remain supported only by third-party posts behind a walled forum page
